Composition & Indication

Liothyronine 25mcg — 100 Tablets (Generic for Cytomel®) contains Liothyronine Sodium (T3) 25 mcg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 100 Tablets at the official 25mcg strength. The standard indication is the management of hypothyroidism, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Liothyronine 25mcg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
